long_biography.plain_text:
Welsh businessman Sir Stanley Thomas developed an early interest in youth clubs as a schoolboy boxer at Merthyr Tydfil YMCA. As president of Clubs for Young People Wales, he helped establish the President's Challenge, taking young participants on walking expeditions across Wales. One challenge led them to design and help make stained-glass panels for the Children's Hospital for Wales.

In Cardiff Bay, Thomas chaired the fundraising committee for a monument to rugby league players Billy Boston, Clive Sullivan and Gus Risman. He made a personal contribution to launch the appeal, which brought together community representatives and sporting organisations. The resulting statue was unveiled in 2023 near the neighbourhoods where the three players grew up.

confidence.reason: Youth organisation retrospective, rugby governing-body announcement and council completion report directly establish the distinct public projects.
